rationale: No existing Traces spec tests the Trace Details Sidebar Scores-block gate. traceGenAiParts.spec.js is themed around GenAI v5 `parts` rendering in the Preview/Thread panes (its helpers open the sidebar but never touch the header toolbar LLM-metrics row or the Scores block); traceDetails.spec.js covers timeline/copy-ID/related-logs/share-link. The Scores gate is a distinct feature (dedicated spec_filename traceDetailsScores.spec.js in run-context), so a new Traces-area spec is the least-duplicative home. The new spec reuses pm.tracesPage + pm.genAiTracesIngestionPage (the exact ingestion/open-sidebar pattern already proven by traceGenAiParts.spec.js).
